properties.statement: [BL-178] The brainstorm skill instructs a call the tool made unnecessary — [BL-152]'s shape a second time
properties.value: {"evidence": "*Found 2026-08-02 by FOLLOWING the skill: it says step 2 is not optional, the tool disagreed, and the tool was right.* brainstorm/SKILL.md step 2 reads *\"set_decision_status to proposed. This call is not optional: add_decision defaults to accepted, which would assert a settlement that never happened.\"* add_decision's own served description says the opposite and dates it: *\"It lands proposed \u2026 BEHAVIOUR CHANGED 2026-07-25: this used to default to accepted.\"* Confirmed empirically \u2014 dec:maturity-restructuring-delta came back proposed with no set_decision_status call. This is [BL-152] exactly (*\"a served skill instructs a call the served tool made unnecessary a week earlier \u2014 the two halves of the served surface disagree\"*), in a second skill, and BL-152 is still open. The wasted call is the small half; the misinformation is the large one \u2014 the skill states a FALSE FACT about the tool's default in bold, so an agent that reads it and skips the redundant call still carries the belief that a bare add_decision asserts a settlement. Worth fixing as the CLASS rather than the instance: BL-152 should be re-read as \"no skill may restate a tool's default\", since a default is exactly the kind of fact that moves under a skill without touching it. Size S", "origin": "Migrated from docs/backlog.md BL-178 on 2026-08-07 (epoch:backlog-retired). Size estimate carried from the row: S."}
